about: The cases of oracle O8 (conformance/sdk/run.mjs) beside the spec's Style Examples table: the spec's own examples (Appendix C, the Parameter Object Examples) and the pitfalls the other generators' tests and changelogs show they fixed (map/research/codegen-2026-11/06-sdk-serialization.md). Each case is an operation (its parameters, requestBody, responses, path after /c<i>, method) generated in each of its versions (3.0.4, 3.1.2 and 3.2.1 when it names none); each call is a request input and what the request must hold (path, query, headers, body exactly; pairs and bodyPairs as WHATWG's form-urlencoded parser reads them), or a response (status, headers, body) and what reading it gives. covers names the requirements each case is evidence for (the ledger reads them).
